name: Warden Rupert

intro.text: The Enclosure has decided this coastline needs curating. Wide beaches, wild dunes and huge skies are a bit uncontrolled. I'm here to tidy them up.

win: Curating, it seems, is harder than it looks.
after: The Enclosure says the dunes will be neatly raked. I have seen the dunes. I have seen the rake.
